name: Madhurjan Thongba
instructions: 1. Mix gram flour with a pinch of salt and water to form a firm dough, then shape into small, thin cylinders or bite-sized balls.
2. Deep-fry the gram flour pieces in oil until golden brown and set aside.
3. In a separate pan, heat oil and temper with cumin seeds, bay leaf, cinnamon, and cardamom.
4. Add ginger paste, turmeric, and chili powder, sautéing until fragrant.
5. Pour in the milk and bring to a gentle boil, ensuring it does not curdle.
6. Add the fried gram flour dumplings to the gravy and simmer until the dumplings absorb the liquid and soften.
7. Finish with a sprinkle of garam masala and serve hot.
description: Madhurjan Thongba is a classic Manipuri vegetarian delicacy often served during religious ceremonies and feasts. It highlights the unique Manipuri culinary style of incorporating milk into savory curries, resulting in a creamy, mild, and comforting dish that pairs well with steamed rice.
